title: Queen Mary 2
short_introduction: Cunard's flagship is a true ocean liner, celebrated for her elegant scale, generous sense of space and the freedom to make each day as restful or as active as you choose.
full_overview:
A modern icon of ocean travel

Queen Mary 2 brings together the ceremony of a classic liner and the choice expected of a contemporary ship. Her grand public rooms, carefully crafted accommodation and spacious decks create an atmosphere that feels unmistakably Cunard.

Days on board can be shaped entirely around you. Settle into the library with a book, enjoy the spa, discover live entertainment or simply watch the ocean pass by. Evenings offer elegant dining rooms, relaxed bars and venues filled with music and dancing.

Above all, Queen Mary 2 is designed to give every guest room to breathe. Whether the voyage is a chance to slow down or an invitation to try something new, life on board can move at your own pace.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Queen Mary 2 offers accommodation for solo travellers, couples and families, ranging from comfortable inside rooms to expansive duplex suites. The choice includes Britannia Inside, Atrium View, Single Oceanview, Oceanview and several Balcony categories, including sheltered and obstructed-view options.

Britannia Club adds a more exclusive dining arrangement, while Princess Grill and Queens Grill suites introduce additional space and a higher level of personal service. At the top of the collection are Queens Grill Queen, Penthouse, Royal, Duplex and Grand Duplex suites.

Whichever category you choose, the emphasis is on comfort, thoughtful craftsmanship and a private place to retreat between the ship's many experiences.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Mary 2

Complimentary and speciality restaurants give the ship a broad range of dining styles, from relaxed meals to evenings with a real sense of occasion. Menus are overseen by Cunard's Global Culinary Ambassador, Jean-Marie Zimmermann.

Queens Grill

Reserved for Queens Grill guests, this refined restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with an exclusive table available throughout the voyage. À la carte choices, an always-available menu and speciality sharing dishes are complemented by attentive service and selected dishes finished at the table.

Princess Grill

Princess Grill guests have their own elegant restaurant, where classical flavour combinations, imaginative cooking and discreet service create a polished experience. A reserved table is available each evening without the need to book.

Britannia and Britannia Club

The grand Britannia Restaurant is the main dining room for Britannia guests, combining classic dishes with international influences. Guests can choose flexible reservations or traditional early and late sittings, while Britannia Club guests enjoy their own dedicated dining arrangement.

Steakhouse at The Verandah

This speciality restaurant focuses on premium steaks and seafood. It is suited to celebratory lunches and dinners, with advance booking recommended and an additional charge applying.

King's Court

For something more casual, King's Court offers international buffet-style food around the clock, including breakfast choices, pizza and sushi. Its relaxed dress code makes it an easy alternative to the ship's formal dining rooms.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Queen Mary 2 balances large-scale productions with atmospheric bars, live music and traditional Cunard occasions.

Royal Court Theatre

The ship's full-sized theatre hosts music, dance and high-energy production shows performed by the Royal Cunard Singers and Dancers.

Queens Room

This grand ballroom is one of the ship's social centres. By day it hosts Cunard's signature afternoon tea and activities such as dance classes. In the evening, chandeliers, live music and a sweeping dance floor set the scene, particularly on Gala Evenings.

G32

Exclusive to Queen Mary 2, this two-level nightclub brings together a resident band, live DJ and lively dance floor. Quieter corners provide space to sit and talk between songs.

Commodore Club

Set high at the bow, the Commodore Club pairs far-reaching sea views with cocktails, fine wines, whisky and evening piano music. It is a particularly inviting place for a sunset drink.

Golden Lion and Carinthia Lounge

The Golden Lion recreates a relaxed British pub with quizzes, darts, occasional sport and live music. Carinthia Lounge changes character throughout the day, moving from light breakfasts and small plates to an evening selection of ports, wines and cocktails.
health_fitness:
Wellbeing at sea

Mareel Wellness & Beauty

Mareel is the ship's calming spa retreat, offering treatments designed to relax, refresh and restore. Treatments can be arranged before sailing, making it easy to reserve time for yourself during the voyage.

Fitness Centre

A fully equipped gym and instructor-led exercise programme help guests maintain their routine at sea. Gym access is included, while personal training, consultations and some classes may carry an additional charge.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Queen Mary 2 welcomes families with supervised spaces and age-appropriate activities included in the fare. Programmes may include games, sports, crafts, challenges and opportunities for younger guests to make friends.

Night Nursery

For children aged 6 to 23 months, the evening nursery provides a supervised place to sleep while parents enjoy dinner, drinks or a show. It operates on a first-come, first-served basis when available.

The Play Zone

Children aged 2 to 7 can take part in themed activities, crafts, games and play led by the Youth Team. Younger infants may use the space with parental supervision.

The Kids Zone

Designed for ages 8 to 12, this dedicated area offers sports, creative activities, friendly challenges and games consoles under the supervision of the Youth Team.

The Teen Zone

Teenagers aged 13 to 17 have their own place to meet, with deck sports, discos, quizzes, video games and team activities.

Exact groupings and programme availability can vary by voyage, particularly on longer sailings.
enrichment:
Time to discover

Queen Mary 2's sense of space makes room for quieter pursuits as well as headline entertainment. Her extensive library offers an inviting place to read, reflect and enjoy time at sea, while the ship's varied daytime programme provides opportunities to learn, socialise and try something different.

title: Queen Anne
short_introduction: Queen Anne brings Cunard's traditions into a fresh era, combining contemporary design, familiar signature venues and the freedom to shape each day around your own idea of a holiday.
full_overview:
Classic Cunard, reimagined

Queen Anne takes inspiration from Cunard's past while setting a confident new design direction. Her interiors pair stylish contemporary details with the ceremony, service and much-loved spaces that make a Cunard voyage distinctive.

Days can move from peaceful time in Mareel Wellness & Beauty to afternoon tea, live music and relaxed drinks overlooking the sea. On Gala Evenings, the Grand Lobby creates an elegant sense of arrival as guests gather in their evening finery.

The experience is designed around choice. You can fill the day with new discoveries or simply enjoy the comfort of the ship, knowing that the finer details have been thoughtfully handled.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Queen Anne's accommodation is styled as a private haven, with calm décor, thoughtful details and somewhere comfortable to return to throughout the day.

Britannia choices include Inside, Oceanview, Deluxe Oceanview and Balcony staterooms, with obstructed-view options also available. Britannia Club Balcony adds access to its dedicated restaurant and a more intimate dining experience.

Princess Grill and Queens Grill suites offer more space and exclusive dining. The Queens Grill collection ranges from suites and penthouses to Master and Grand Suites, with personal bars among the additional touches available in selected accommodation.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Anne

Queen Anne offers a broad choice of dining styles, from classic Cunard restaurants to casual food, lighter bites and afternoon treats throughout the day.

Queens Grill

Queens Grill guests dine in an intimate restaurant with attentive service and a table reserved for the duration of the voyage. Flexible dining and the opportunity to make special culinary requests create an especially personal experience.

Princess Grill

The Princess Grill Restaurant combines an exclusive setting with accomplished service and a varied menu. Guests return to the same reserved table and may dine whenever they wish.

Britannia

Calming colours inspired by the seasons shape the Britannia Restaurant, where generous menus, carefully matched wines and Cunard's White Star Service turn dinner into an occasion.

Britannia Club

Reserved for Britannia Club guests, this more intimate restaurant serves contemporary and international dishes with an exclusive table held throughout the voyage.

Alongside these main restaurants, Queen Anne introduces additional venues and plenty of opportunities for casual meals, light bites and spontaneous indulgence.
entertainment:
Bars, music and social spaces

Queen Anne's public rooms offer places for morning coffee, ocean views, live music, cocktails and evenings spent with new friends.

Carinthia Lounge

Set above the Grand Lobby, Carinthia Lounge moves easily from pastries and barista coffee in the morning to small plates, charcuterie, wine and live music later in the day.

Golden Lion

Cunard's familiar pub venue offers a relaxed counterpoint to the ship's more formal spaces and an easy place to meet over a drink.

Chart Room

This refined cocktail lounge serves hot and cold drinks by day before turning to signature cocktails inspired by constellations and the night sky.

Commodore Club

High on Deck 12, the art deco-inspired Commodore Club pairs sweeping views with plush seating, evening drinks and the sound of a live piano.

Grand Lobby Boutiques

The ship's boutiques bring together fashion, jewellery and Cunard keepsakes, including a dedicated Cunard Collection store and the first Garrard fine-jewellery boutique at sea.
health_fitness:
Wellbeing your way

Queen Anne treats wellness as something personal, whether that means quiet spa time, a challenging workout or a restorative session overlooking the ocean.

Mareel Wellness & Beauty Spa

The spa draws inspiration from the sea, with a thermal pool, steam and sauna experiences, a cold room, Himalayan salt sauna and heated loungers. Marine-inspired treatments add another layer of relaxation.

Mareel Salon

The salon and treatment programme includes skincare, body therapies and recovery-focused options, supported by wellness workshops and specialist practitioners.

Fitness Centre

Cardio equipment, free weights, a sprung floor and spin studio provide the foundations for an independent workout or a session supported by a personal trainer.

Pavilion Wellness Studio

This Queen Anne venue uses its ocean outlook as a backdrop for yoga, meditation, Pilates, circuits and other guided sessions, with outdoor deck space close by.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Children are welcomed aboard Queen Anne, with dedicated clubs, supervised programmes and activities such as crafts, sport, play and computer games.

The Play Zone is designed for children aged 2 to 7, while older children and teenagers can meet in age-appropriate spaces. Cunard's Youth Team organises events, competitions and activities, helping younger guests enjoy the voyage and make new friends.

Access to the children's clubs is included in the fare. Exact programmes and age groupings may vary by voyage.
enrichment:
Cunard traditions and time at sea

Queen Anne's days are shaped by small rituals as much as headline experiences. Afternoon tea brings a sense of ceremony, live music changes the mood of her lounges, and her blend of classic and contemporary design rewards time spent simply exploring the ship.

title: Queen Elizabeth
short_introduction: Queen Elizabeth pairs evocative art deco elegance with spacious decks, polished public rooms and a relaxed freedom to choose between entertainment, dining, activity and quiet time.
full_overview:
Art deco elegance at sea

Queen Elizabeth has a refined character shaped by gleaming chandeliers, art deco details and generous public spaces. Her decks and lounges create an uncrowded setting for a voyage that can be as sociable or as restful as you prefer.

Spend the day playing croquet, relaxing in the Garden Lounge or enjoying the ship's spa and pools. In the evening, theatrical performances, live music, dancing and elegant dining provide plenty of reasons to dress for the occasion.

Contemporary comforts sit comfortably alongside Cunard traditions, creating a ship with a distinctive sense of style and an easy rhythm of life.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Every Queen Elizabeth stateroom and suite is designed as a private retreat. Room service, a film, a book and the comfort of your own space can be every bit as appealing as a busy day around the ship.

Britannia accommodation ranges from Standard, Deluxe and Single Inside rooms to Oceanview, Single Oceanview and Balcony staterooms, including obstructed-view choices. Britannia Club Balcony adds a dedicated restaurant and more flexible dining.

Princess Grill and Queens Grill suites introduce additional space and exclusive restaurants. Queens Grill choices include suites, penthouses, Master Suites and Grand Suites for guests seeking the ship's most expansive accommodation.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Elizabeth

Main dining is linked to accommodation grade, with Britannia, Britannia Club, Princess Grill and Queens Grill restaurants included for their respective guests. Casual alternatives add flexibility throughout the day.

Queens Grill

Exclusive to Queens Grill guests, this fine-dining restaurant offers a reserved table, flexible arrival times and breakfast, lunch and dinner. À la carte dishes, speciality sharing plates and tableside presentation bring a sense of theatre.

Princess Grill

Princess Grill combines imaginative classical cooking with discreet service. Guests have a reserved table and can dine within the evening's flexible service window without making a booking.

Britannia Restaurant

Chandeliers, polished wood and white linen define this grand art deco dining room. Its menus span seafood, steaks and carefully presented dishes served with Cunard's White Star Service.

Britannia Club

Britannia Club guests dine in a dedicated art deco restaurant with sea views, a reserved table and a choice of its own à la carte dishes or the Britannia menu.

Lido Restaurant

The Lido offers a more relaxed, buffet-style approach, with salads, burgers and varied dishes served against wide ocean views.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Queen Elizabeth offers grand performance spaces, lively venues and quieter lounges, giving each evening a different character.

Royal Court Theatre

Rich colours and theatre boxes create an elegant setting for musical productions, guest speakers and visiting performers.

Queens Room

The Queens Room is the ship's ballroom and a natural home for live music, dance workshops and evenings beneath the chandeliers.

Garden Lounge

Inspired by Mediterranean gardens and glass conservatories, this light-filled lounge offers sea views, greenery, comfortable seating and live music across the day.

Commodore Club

Set high above the sea, the Commodore Club combines panoramic views, cocktails, piano music and an intimate atmosphere.

Golden Lion and Empire Casino

The Golden Lion recreates a convivial British pub with food, quizzes, karaoke, sport and music. The Empire Casino brings blackjack, poker, roulette and slot machines, with introductory workshops for new players.

Grills Lounge

Princess and Queens Grill guests also have an exclusive lounge for drinks, complimentary tea and coffee, cards and conversation.
health_fitness:
Wellbeing and activity

Queen Elizabeth provides several ways to stay active or slow the pace, from open-air games and pool time to spa treatments and structured workouts.

Mareel Spa

Mareel offers sauna, steam and pool facilities alongside massages, facials, body treatments and occasional wellness seminars.

Fitness Centre

Cardio and strength equipment, free weights and fitness accessories support independent workouts. Instructor-led classes and personal training may be available for an additional charge.

Lido Pool

The Lido Deck is a relaxed place to swim, sunbathe and spend time with a book, with refreshments available close to the pool.

Games Deck

Bowls, croquet, deck tennis, golf nets and giant chess provide sociable outdoor activity, with tournaments offered on selected days.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Queen Elizabeth welcomes children with supervised clubs, creative activities, sport, games and spaces designed for different ages.

Night Nursery

For children aged 6 to 23 months, the evening nursery offers a supervised place to sleep while parents enjoy the ship. Places are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Play Zone

Children aged 2 to 7 can enjoy themed days, crafts, games, toys and a sheltered outdoor play area with the Youth Team.

Kids Zone

Ages 8 to 12 have their own programme of sport, creative activities, games consoles and friendly challenges.

Teen Zone

Teenagers aged 13 to 17 can join deck sports, discos, quizzes, gaming and team activities in a dedicated social space.

Exact age groupings and supervised-club availability can vary by voyage, particularly on longer sailings.
enrichment:
Days shaped by curiosity

Queen Elizabeth's quieter spaces and daytime activities make it easy to follow your own interests. Read in the Garden Lounge, try croquet or bowls on the Games Deck, join a dance session or attend one of the talks and performances scheduled around the ship.

title: Queen Victoria
short_introduction: Queen Victoria combines warm hospitality, elegant public rooms and an easy sense of escapism, with the freedom to move between ocean views, thoughtful activities, fine dining and live entertainment.
full_overview:
Elegant days, memorable evenings

Queen Victoria has a distinctive appeal built around graceful interiors, light-filled spaces and attentive Cunard service. From the moment you board, the ship is designed to feel removed from everyday life.

Days might be spent in the Winter Garden, on a sunny deck or listening to a Cunard Insights speaker. There is time to read, learn something new or simply watch the sea. As evening arrives, the choice opens into refined restaurants, sociable bars and productions in the Royal Court Theatre.

There is no fixed way to experience Queen Victoria. Her mix of quiet corners and lively occasions gives every guest the freedom to create a voyage at their own pace.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Queen Victoria accommodates solo travellers, couples and families across a wide range of rooms and suites.

Britannia choices include Standard and Deluxe Inside rooms, Single Inside and Single Oceanview rooms, Oceanview accommodation and several Balcony categories, including partially obstructed and obstructed-view options. Britannia Club Balcony adds access to a dedicated restaurant.

Princess Grill suites provide more space and exclusive dining, while Queens Grill accommodation ranges from Queen Suites and Penthouses to Master Suites and Grand Duplexes.

Across every grade, the room offers a comfortable private base for days ashore and time spent enjoying the ship.
dining:
Dining aboard Queen Victoria

Queen Victoria moves from casual buffet dining and nourishing light dishes to grand restaurants and speciality evenings. Main dining is linked to the guest's accommodation category.

Queens Grill

Queens Grill guests have an exclusive fine-dining restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner. A reserved table, flexible arrival times, à la carte menus and selected dishes presented tableside create a highly personal experience.

Princess Grill

Princess Grill offers elevated à la carte dining, discreet service and a table reserved throughout the voyage, with flexible evening dining.

Britannia Restaurant

This grand two-tiered room serves Britannia guests at breakfast, lunch and dinner. Daily menus include meat, fish and vegan choices alongside cooked and continental breakfast favourites.

Steakhouse at The Verandah

The Verandah is a speciality venue for premium steaks and seafood, including shellfish platters and Black Angus and Wagyu cuts. Additional charges apply.

The Lido

The Lido offers an informal buffet with changing hot dishes, salads, sushi, afternoon-tea favourites and late-night food.

Pavilion Wellness Café

Fresh juices, smoothies, salads, grain bowls and light bites provide a more nourishing option in a relaxed setting.
entertainment:
Entertainment and social spaces

Queen Victoria's bars and lounges range from art deco cocktails and panoramic piano music to pub quizzes and late-night dancing.

Chart Room

Brushed-gold art deco details set the tone for this cocktail bar near the Grand Lobby, where the signature list draws inspiration from the signs of the zodiac.

Commodore Club

Picture-height windows at the bow frame wide sea views, complemented by speciality cocktails, early-evening canapés and live piano music.

Yacht Club

Talks, choir rehearsals and dance classes take place here by day. At night, karaoke and DJs turn the nautical lounge into Queen Victoria's late-night venue.

Golden Lion

This traditional pub combines draught beer, classic food, quizzes, sport and live music in an informal setting.

Queens Room and Grand Lobby

The Queens Room hosts dancing, afternoon tea and Gala Evening occasions, while the Grand Lobby provides Queen Victoria's formal centre and a memorable sense of arrival.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

Queen Victoria supports both active routines and unhurried wellbeing, with a dedicated spa and an enhanced fitness space.

Mareel Wellness & Beauty

Mareel offers massages, facials, body wraps, scrubs and other therapies delivered by specialist practitioners in a calm setting.

Fitness Centre

Cardio and strength equipment support independent training, while group classes range from energetic workouts to gentler yoga sessions. Personal training can also be arranged.

Elsewhere on board, open decks, sports facilities and quieter sea-view spaces provide further ways to move, rest and reset.
younger_travellers:
Travelling with children

Queen Victoria's family programme includes supervised clubs, age-appropriate activities and dedicated places for children and teenagers to meet.

Night Nursery

Children aged 6 to 23 months can sleep in a supervised evening nursery while parents enjoy dinner or a show. Places are offered on a first-come, first-served basis.

Play Zone

For ages 2 to 7, the Youth Team organises themed activities, crafts, games and play, with younger infants welcome when accompanied by a parent.

Kids Zone

Children aged 8 to 12 can join sport, creative sessions, challenges and console games in their own dedicated area.

Teen Zone

Ages 13 to 17 have a social space with deck sports, discos, quizzes, gaming and team activities.

Programmes, age groupings and supervision can vary according to the voyage and the number of younger guests travelling.
enrichment:
Ideas for days at sea

Queen Victoria's Cunard Insights speakers bring expert perspectives to the voyage, while daytime talks, choir rehearsals and dance classes offer further ways to take part. Guests who prefer a quieter pace can settle into the Winter Garden or find a comfortable place to read while the ocean passes by.

title: Celebrity Edge
short_introduction: Celebrity Edge brings the sea closer through an outward-facing design, imaginative open-air spaces and contemporary accommodation. From the soaring Magic Carpet to Infinite Veranda staterooms, the first Edge Series ship reshapes how guests experience life on the water.
full_overview:
A new perspective on modern cruising

Celebrity Edge introduced a new generation of Celebrity ships, designed from the outset to strengthen the connection between guests, the ocean and the destinations they visit. Her architecture turns naturally outwards, with generous views, open-air spaces and design details that make the changing scenery part of everyday life on board.

The ship's signature Magic Carpet moves between decks to serve different purposes throughout the day, while the Resort Deck brings together a spacious pool area, rooftop garden and places to relax in the open air. Inside, contemporary public rooms move easily from calm daytime retreats to atmospheric evening venues.

Celebrity Edge combines this bold design with the polished, approachable service associated with Celebrity Cruises. Fast Starlink connectivity, a broad choice of dining and accommodation, and experiences for couples, solo travellers and families make her a versatile ship for modern ocean holidays.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Accommodation aboard Celebrity Edge ranges from practical inside and ocean-view rooms to innovative veranda staterooms and an extensive collection of suites. The design emphasises space, light and understated contemporary comfort, with interiors influenced by designer Kelly Hoppen.

Edge Staterooms with Infinite Veranda

These distinctive rooms bring the veranda into the living space. At the touch of a button, the upper section of the window lowers to open the room to fresh air and sea views, creating a flexible setting that can feel larger and brighter throughout the day.

The Retreat

Suite guests become part of The Retreat, with access to an exclusive sundeck, private lounge and Luminae restaurant, alongside dedicated service. Choices range from Sky Suites and Magic Carpet Sky Suites to Celebrity, Royal and Penthouse Suites.

At the top of the collection, two-storey Edge Villas feature private terraces and plunge pools, while the expansive Iconic Suites sit above the bridge with far-reaching views. Aqua Sky Suites combine the suite experience with AquaClass wellness benefits.

AquaClass and Concierge Class

AquaClass staterooms introduce a wellbeing focus, including access to Blu restaurant and the SEA Thermal Suite. Concierge Class adds thoughtful touches and service designed to make settling into the voyage easier.

Solo Infinite Veranda rooms, connecting accommodation and accessible options broaden the choice for different travelling parties. Most rooms feature king-sized beds fitted with Celebrity's eXhale bedding and Cashmere Mattress.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Edge

Celebrity Edge offers a wide-ranging collection of restaurants, cafés and bars, from relaxed daytime venues to theatrical speciality dining. Four complimentary main restaurants replace the traditional single main dining room, giving each evening a different sense of place.

Four main restaurants

Tuscan Restaurant draws on the warmth and flavours of Italy, while Cyprus celebrates Mediterranean cooking with a particular nod to Greek cuisine. Cosmopolitan offers a contemporary take on familiar favourites, and Normandie brings French inspiration to an elegant setting. Celebrity Select Dining provides flexibility over dining times and venues.

Restaurants for suite and AquaClass guests

Luminae at The Retreat is reserved for suite guests, with menus created for the venue and a refined, intimate atmosphere. Blu is the dedicated restaurant for AquaClass guests, focusing on clean, imaginative dishes in a calm setting.

Speciality experiences

Fine Cut Steakhouse pairs premium cuts and seafood with an energetic open-kitchen atmosphere. Eden Restaurant combines inventive food with one of the ship's most distinctive spaces, while Raw on 5 focuses on seafood and Japanese-inspired dishes. Le Grand Bistro evokes a French café, and selected sailings feature the animated Le Petit Chef dining experience.

Rooftop Garden Grill offers open-air dining, and the cantilevered Magic Carpet changes character according to its position. For informal meals there is Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café & Juice Bar and Eden Café, alongside coffee and pastries at Café al Bacio and the convenience of room service.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Entertainment on Celebrity Edge is closely tied to the ship's design. Venues are immersive and adaptable, with performances, live music and social spaces unfolding around the guests rather than remaining confined to a conventional stage.

The Theatre

The ship's main theatre uses advanced production technology and an unusual stage configuration to create original shows with music, movement and visual effects. Its design helps performers appear from unexpected directions and brings the audience closer to the action.

Eden

By day, Eden is a light-filled, multi-level retreat with sweeping views across the wake. As evening arrives, it evolves into a more atmospheric setting for cocktails, dining and creative entertainment.

Grand Plaza and Martini Bar

The Grand Plaza forms a lively heart of the ship, bringing restaurants and bars together around the dramatic Martini Bar. It is a natural meeting point before dinner and becomes increasingly energetic as live music and evening activity begin.

Magic Carpet and outdoor spaces

The Magic Carpet rises along the side of the ship and serves as a bar, lounge or dining space depending on its deck position. Elsewhere, the Resort Deck, Rooftop Garden, Sunset Bar and Pool Bar provide relaxed open-air alternatives.

Guests can also spend an evening in The Club, try their luck in the Edge Casino, browse the onboard shops or choose from a varied collection of cocktail and lounge bars.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa on Celebrity Edge brings together restorative treatments, thermal experiences, beauty services and fitness facilities in a calm contemporary setting. More than 120 treatments are available, allowing guests to shape their time around relaxation, recovery or a renewed sense of energy.

SEA Thermal Suite

This collection of therapeutic spaces uses heat, water and sensory experiences to encourage deep relaxation. Access is included for AquaClass guests and may also be arranged separately, subject to availability.

Fitness Centre

The Fitness Centre offers modern equipment and space for individual workouts, alongside a programme of classes and specialist sessions. Guests can also make use of outdoor activities such as pickleball.

Places to unwind

The adults-only Solarium provides a peaceful poolside retreat in all weather. Suite guests have the additional privacy of The Retreat Sundeck, while the onboard salon and barber offer hair, grooming and beauty appointments.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Celebrity Edge welcomes families with supervised activities, shared experiences and spaces designed for different ages. The programme can vary by sailing, allowing the youth team to respond to the interests and age mix of the children travelling.

Camp at Sea

Celebrity's Camp at Sea programme is designed for children aged 3 to 12 and draws on a collection of more than 500 possible activities. Days may include creative projects, games, recreation, culinary sessions and science, technology, engineering and maths activities.

Age-appropriate groups include Shipmates, Cadets and Captains, helping children take part with others at a similar stage. A dedicated Teen Club gives older children their own place to meet, relax and join organised activities.

Time together

Family activities can include movie nights, pool time and shore experiences. Celebrity also offers autism-friendly cruising support, with trained staff and sensory-aware options intended to make holidays more comfortable for autistic guests and their families.
enrichment:
Discover more along the way

Celebrity Edge is designed not only as a destination in herself but as a gateway to the places on the itinerary. Destination-focused spaces and shore excursions help guests move from life on board to meaningful time ashore.

Destination Gateway

The Destination Gateway supports the transition between ship and shore, providing a practical and welcoming departure point for excursions. When the Magic Carpet is positioned at sea level, the area becomes part of the embarkation experience for tender destinations.

Shore excursions

A varied programme of excursions offers ways to explore each port, from key landmarks and local culture to food, scenery and more active experiences. Exact choices depend on the sailing and destination.

title: Celebrity Apex
short_introduction: Celebrity Apex is the second Edge Series ship, combining an outward-facing design with the Magic Carpet, Rooftop Garden and a polished resort atmosphere. Contemporary accommodation, imaginative dining and spaces that flow towards the sea make her an elegant choice for modern ocean travel.
full_overview:
Edge Series style, refined

Celebrity Apex builds on the ideas introduced by Celebrity Edge, using architecture and open-air spaces to keep the ocean and destination in view. The cantilevered Magic Carpet changes purpose as it moves between decks, while the Rooftop Garden offers a relaxed setting for films, music and time outdoors.

Inside, the Grand Plaza, Eden and The Club shift naturally from daytime gathering places to lively evening venues. The ship balances this contemporary energy with attentive Celebrity service, The Retreat for suite guests and Starlink connectivity throughout the voyage.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Celebrity Apex offers one of the fleet's broadest accommodation choices, including solo rooms, connecting options and Edge Staterooms with Infinite Verandas that open the living space to fresh air at the touch of a button.

The Retreat collection ranges from Sky Suites and two-storey Edge Villas to expansive Penthouse and Iconic Suites, with an exclusive lounge, sundeck and Luminae restaurant. AquaClass includes access to Blu and the SEA Thermal Suite, while Concierge Class adds dedicated service and thoughtful arrival touches. Ocean-view, veranda, inside and accessible rooms complete the range.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Apex

Four complimentary main restaurants give dinner a different character each evening: Tuscan, Cyprus, Cosmopolitan and Normandie. Suite guests have Luminae, while AquaClass guests dine in Blu.

Speciality choices include Fine Cut Steakhouse, Eden Restaurant, Raw on 5, Le Grand Bistro and its animated Le Petit Chef experience. Rooftop Garden Grill and the Magic Carpet bring dining into the open air, while Oceanview Café, Eden Café, Spa Café, Mast Grill and Café al Bacio keep informal options close at hand. Craft Social adds a casual bar for beer, wine and cocktails.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Theatre uses advanced staging for original productions, while Eden blends panoramic views, cocktails and immersive performance. The Club hosts live entertainment and late-night events, and the Grand Plaza gathers guests around the dramatic Martini Bar.

Outdoors, the Resort Deck, Magic Carpet and Sunset Bar make the sea part of the experience. Guests can also visit the casino, browse the shops or settle into Craft Social, Café al Bacio and the ship's varied lounges.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa offers more than 120 treatments alongside the sensory spaces of the SEA Thermal Suite. The Fitness Centre supports independent workouts and organised sessions, while pickleball adds an outdoor option.

The adults-only Solarium provides a quieter pool environment, and suite guests have The Retreat Sundeck. A salon and barber complete the ship's wellbeing and grooming services.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea provides a flexible programme for children aged 3 to 12, drawing on arts, recreation, culinary activities, themed events and science-led sessions. Teenagers have their own club and informal programme, with opportunities to meet others of a similar age.

Family time may include pool days, theatre, films under the stars and suitable shore excursions. Autism-friendly support is also available, although exact activities and operating times vary by sailing.
enrichment:
Destination-led discovery

The Destination Gateway helps guests move smoothly between ship and shore and becomes especially distinctive when the Magic Carpet supports tender embarkation. Excursions offer ways to explore local culture, scenery, food and active adventures, with choices varying by itinerary.

Meeting spaces and destination programming add context to the places visited, while selected Caribbean sailings may include a day at Perfect Day at CocoCay.

title: Celebrity Ascent
short_introduction: Celebrity Ascent brings the Edge Series to its most expansive expression, with a multi-level Sunset Bar, Rooftop Garden, Magic Carpet and 32 distinctive places to dine and drink. The result is a sophisticated resort at sea that keeps destinations and ocean views at the heart of the experience.
full_overview:
The Edge Series rises again

As the fourth Edge Series ship, Celebrity Ascent combines the class's best-known spaces with thoughtful refinements of her own. The open-air Rooftop Garden, cantilevered Magic Carpet and generous Resort Deck create an easy connection to the sea, while the terraced Sunset Bar is designed for long views across the wake.

Inside, Eden, the Grand Plaza and The Club give the ship several different social centres. Contemporary design, destination-led experiences and The Retreat's private spaces create a holiday that can move effortlessly between lively and restorative.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

The choice ranges from inside and ocean-view rooms to Infinite Verandas, solo accommodation and private veranda staterooms. Infinite Verandas extend the living area towards the sea, while connecting configurations help families and groups travel together.

The Retreat includes Sky Suites, Aqua Sky Suites, two-storey Edge Villas, Penthouse Suites and forward-facing Iconic Suites, supported by an exclusive lounge, sundeck and Luminae. AquaClass adds Blu and thermal-suite access; Concierge Class adds enhanced service and selected onboard benefits.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Ascent

Celebrity Ascent's four complimentary main restaurants are Cyprus, Tuscan, Cosmopolitan and Normandie. Luminae serves The Retreat, while Blu is reserved for AquaClass guests.

Le Voyage by Daniel Boulud offers the ship's most distinctive fine-dining experience. Other speciality choices include Fine Cut Steakhouse, Eden Restaurant, Raw on 5, Le Grand Bistro, Le Petit Chef and Rooftop Garden Grill. Oceanview Café, Spa Café, Eden Café and Mast Grill cover more relaxed meals, with the ship's bars and lounges extending the choice well beyond dinner.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Theatre presents original productions supported by immersive technology, while Eden brings performance, music and cocktails into a multi-level space overlooking the wake. The Club hosts late-night events and adaptable entertainment.

The Grand Plaza and Martini Bar form a lively meeting point, complemented by World Class Bar, Craft Social and the spacious Sunset Bar. The Magic Carpet, Rooftop Garden, casino and onboard shops provide further ways to shape an evening.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa and Fitness Centre support both active and restorative days, with a wide treatment menu, contemporary exercise equipment and the sensory environments of the SEA Thermal Suite.

The Solarium offers an adults-only retreat, while The Retreat Sundeck is reserved for suite guests. Pickleball, the main pool, salon and barber add further wellbeing choices.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea gives children aged 3 to 12 a changing programme of creative, recreational, culinary and STEM-inspired activities. Teenagers have a separate social space with organised events and the freedom to join throughout the day.

Families can share theatre, outdoor films, pool time and shore excursions. Exact schedules vary by voyage, and autism-friendly support is available for guests who may benefit from it.
enrichment:
Closer to the destination

The Destination Gateway supports shore departures and tender operations, while the ship's excursion programme covers culture, scenery, food and active exploration. The design of Ascent keeps the landscape visible even when guests are back on board.

Selected itineraries may include Mediterranean ports or Perfect Day at CocoCay, with the exact destination programme shaped around each sailing.

title: Celebrity Beyond
short_introduction: Celebrity Beyond takes the outward-facing Edge Series concept further, with expanded open-air spaces, a larger Retreat and a collection of 32 food and drink venues. From the terraced Sunset Bar to Le Voyage by Daniel Boulud, she is designed for travellers who want contemporary luxury with a strong sense of place.
full_overview:
Designed to go beyond

Celebrity Beyond extends the Edge Series both physically and creatively. Her Resort Deck, Rooftop Garden and multi-level Sunset Bar offer more room to live outdoors, while the Magic Carpet travels along the side of the ship to become a lounge, dining venue or embarkation platform.

Eden, the Grand Plaza and The Club create distinctive indoor worlds, and The Retreat has been expanded for suite guests. The overall mood is confident and modern, with art, landscape and far-reaching views woven into the experience.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Infinite Veranda rooms make the sea-facing window part of the living area, and the ship includes an increased number of solo versions for independent travellers. Veranda, ocean-view, inside, Concierge Class and AquaClass accommodation provide options across a wide range of budgets and preferences.

The Retreat includes Sky Suites, Aqua Sky Suites, Edge Villas, Royal, Celebrity, Penthouse and Iconic Suites. Guests receive access to Luminae, The Retreat Lounge and a private sundeck, with extra space and dedicated service shaping the suite experience.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Beyond

Four complimentary main restaurants—Cyprus, Tuscan, Cosmopolitan and Normandie—offer distinct interiors and regional influences. Luminae is exclusive to The Retreat and Blu serves AquaClass guests.

Le Voyage by Daniel Boulud leads the speciality collection, joined by Fine Cut Steakhouse, Eden Restaurant, Raw on 5, Le Grand Bistro, Le Petit Chef and Rooftop Garden Grill. Informal choices include Oceanview Café, Eden Café, Spa Café, Mast Grill and Café al Bacio, with the Magic Carpet adding one of the fleet's most memorable settings.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Theatre delivers technically ambitious productions, while Eden combines live performance with a dramatic setting across three levels. The Club shifts between daytime activities and late-night entertainment.

The Grand Plaza and Martini Bar bring energy to the centre of the ship, and guests can also explore the Jazz Joint, World Class Bar, Craft Social, Sunset Bar, casino and shops. Outdoor spaces remain part of the evening, particularly around the Rooftop Garden and Magic Carpet.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

Celebrity Beyond places wellbeing at the centre of the holiday through The Spa, Fitness Centre and SEA Thermal Suite. Treatments, exercise sessions and spaces designed for quiet restoration can be combined into a personalised routine.

The Solarium offers adults-only relaxation, The Retreat Sundeck provides privacy for suite guests, and pickleball adds a more sociable outdoor activity. Salon and barber services are also available.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea adapts its programme to the children travelling, with activities spanning art, recreation, cookery and science. Separate age groups help younger guests take part with their peers, while teenagers have their own club and social programme.

Pool time, shows, films and family-friendly excursions create opportunities to spend time together. Autism-friendly support is available, with exact services and schedules varying by voyage.
enrichment:
Discovery on board and ashore

Celebrity Beyond treats the ship as part of the destination experience. The Destination Gateway supports excursions and tender departures, while the outward-facing design keeps the landscape present throughout the day.

Excursions may focus on local culture, natural scenery, food or more active adventures. Selected Caribbean voyages may also include Perfect Day at CocoCay.

title: Celebrity Constellation
short_introduction: Celebrity Constellation offers a more intimate Celebrity experience, combining elegant public rooms, a broad dining collection and the comforts of AquaClass and The Retreat. Her manageable scale and relaxed atmosphere suit travellers who value destination-rich itineraries and familiar, sociable spaces.
full_overview:
Classic Celebrity character

Celebrity Constellation belongs to the Millennium Series, giving her a more intimate feel than the newer resort-style ships while retaining the dining, service and wellbeing experiences associated with Celebrity Cruises.

Days can move from the Rooftop Terrace and pool deck to the light-filled Grand Foyer, Sky Observation Lounge and quiet corners around the ship. Evenings bring theatre, live music, bars and dining without losing the easy sense of scale that many guests value.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Accommodation includes inside, ocean-view and veranda rooms alongside Concierge Class and spa-inspired AquaClass. AquaClass guests receive access to Blu and the Persian Garden, while Concierge Class adds selected events and dedicated support.

The Retreat suite collection includes Sky, Celebrity, Royal and Penthouse Suites, with access to Luminae and The Retreat Lounge. Accessible rooms and family-friendly configurations broaden the choice across the ship.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Constellation

The Main Restaurant provides the ship's principal complimentary dining experience, with Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service covering more informal meals.

Speciality choices include Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and the animated Le Petit Chef experience. Blu is reserved for AquaClass guests and Luminae serves The Retreat, while Café al Bacio and Gelateria is a natural stop for coffee and something sweet.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Main Theatre hosts production shows and visiting entertainment, complemented by events and parties around the ship. Rendezvous Lounge, Martini Bar and Cellar Masters offer different moods for drinks and live music.

The Rooftop Terrace brings films and sea views into the open air, while the Sky Observation Lounge, Fortunes Casino, Grand Foyer and shops provide further evening choices.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa combines treatments with the thermal surroundings of the Persian Garden. The Fitness Centre supports independent exercise and organised sessions, with pickleball available for guests who prefer activity outdoors.

The Solarium creates a quieter adults-only setting, while the main pool offers a livelier alternative. Salon and barber services complete the wellbeing collection.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea offers supervised activities for children, with age groups, creative projects, recreation and culinary sessions shaped around the guests on each sailing. Teenagers have opportunities to meet and join their own programme.

Families can share theatre, pool time, games and suitable excursions. Autism-friendly support is available, although exact facilities and schedules should be checked for the chosen voyage.
enrichment:
Exploring beyond the ship

Celebrity Constellation's excursion programme helps guests discover the culture, landscapes and landmarks of each itinerary. Choices can range from introductory sightseeing to food, wildlife and active experiences.

Her intimate scale and comfortable observation spaces make the ship a calm base between days ashore.

title: Celebrity Eclipse
short_introduction: Celebrity Eclipse combines the open lawns and generous public spaces of the Solstice Series with destination-led dining, lively bars and a relaxed resort atmosphere. The Lawn Club, Hot Glass Class Studio and wide range of accommodation give sea days a character of their own.
full_overview:
Space to unwind and explore

Celebrity Eclipse is shaped around the Solstice Series idea of bringing unexpected outdoor experiences to sea. The real-grass Lawn Club offers room to read, listen to music or simply enjoy the view, while the pool deck and Solstice Deck provide further open-air space.

Inside, the Grand Foyer, Sky Observation Lounge and Ensemble Lounge create different places to gather throughout the day. Evenings can be as lively or as unhurried as guests choose, supported by theatre, bars, dining and casino entertainment.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Inside, ocean-view and veranda accommodation is joined by Concierge Class and AquaClass. AquaClass includes access to Blu and the Persian Garden, while Concierge Class adds service touches and selected events.

The Retreat's suites provide more space, dedicated service and access to Luminae and The Retreat Lounge. Accessible rooms and a range of veranda categories help suit different travelling parties.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Eclipse

The Main Restaurant anchors the complimentary offering, supported by Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service. Café al Bacio and Gelateria serves coffee, pastries and sweet treats through the day.

Speciality restaurants include the refined Murano, Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef. Blu is reserved for AquaClass and Luminae serves suite guests, giving each premium accommodation collection its own dining room.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Main Theatre presents production shows and visiting acts, while Quasar, Ensemble Lounge and Sky Observation Lounge offer music, dancing and later evenings. Martini Bar, World Class Bar, Passport Bar and Sunset Bar each bring a different atmosphere.

The Lawn Club and open decks provide an outdoor alternative, and guests can also visit the casino, gallery, shops, library or take part in the ship's varied daily programme.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa offers treatments and restorative time in the Persian Garden, while the Fitness Centre provides equipment and classes. AquaClass guests receive associated spa benefits.

The adults-only Solarium is a peaceful poolside retreat, complemented by pickleball, salon services and the barber.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea offers supervised, age-appropriate activities that may include arts, recreation, culinary projects and STEM sessions. Teenagers have their own opportunities to socialise and join organised events.

Families can enjoy the pool deck, outdoor films, theatre and excursions together. Exact programmes vary by sailing, and autism-friendly support is available.
enrichment:
Learning through the journey

The Hot Glass Class Studio gives guests an unusual opportunity to engage with glassmaking at sea, while Team Earth brings environmental ideas into the onboard experience.

A broad excursion programme extends discovery ashore through cultural, active, family and wellbeing-focused options, depending on the itinerary.

title: Celebrity Equinox
short_introduction: Celebrity Equinox pairs Solstice Series space and greenery with refreshed interiors, The Retreat Sundeck and a varied collection of restaurants and bars. She offers an easy balance of relaxed outdoor living, polished dining and destination-focused days ashore.
full_overview:
A refreshed Solstice Series favourite

Celebrity Equinox combines the class's signature Lawn Club and broad open decks with updated public spaces and technology. The Retreat adds a private sundeck and lounge for suite guests, while the main pool and observation spaces keep sea views central to the wider ship.

Craft Social, the Main Theatre and a collection of lounges create plenty of evening choice. The atmosphere remains sociable and contemporary without losing the calm, spacious quality that defines the Solstice Series.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Accommodation ranges from inside and ocean-view rooms to veranda categories, Concierge Class and AquaClass. Updated interiors, eXhale bedding and practical storage create a comfortable base throughout the voyage.

The Retreat suite experience includes access to Luminae, an exclusive lounge and private sundeck. AquaClass guests dine in Blu and use the Persian Garden, while Concierge Class adds selected services and events.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Equinox

The Main Restaurant is joined by Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service for complimentary and informal dining. Café al Bacio and Gelateria provides coffee and sweet treats.

Tuscan Grille and Murano lead the speciality collection, alongside Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef. Luminae is exclusive to The Retreat, while Blu serves AquaClass guests with a lighter, wellness-led menu.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Main Theatre hosts shows and guest entertainment, while Sky Observation Lounge, Quasar and Ensemble Lounge offer live music, dancing and social space. Craft Social brings a casual setting for beer and cocktails.

Martini Bar, World Class Bar, Passport Bar and Sunset Bar create different moods across the ship. The Lawn Club, casino, gallery, shops and organised events add further choice.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa, Persian Garden and Fitness Centre make it easy to combine treatments, thermal relaxation and exercise. The Solarium offers an adults-only pool environment away from the livelier main deck.

Pickleball, salon appointments and barber services round out the wellbeing programme, while suite guests have The Retreat Sundeck.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea adapts its supervised programme around the children on board, with creative, recreational, culinary and STEM-led sessions. Teenagers have a separate space and social activities.

Families can share films, shows, pool time and suitable shore excursions. Autism-friendly support is available, with exact provision varying between voyages.
enrichment:
Creative and destination discovery

The Hot Glass Class Studio gives guests a hands-on creative experience at sea. Beyond the ship, excursions can focus on culture, local life, active exploration, wellness or family experiences.

The exact programme follows the itinerary, giving each sailing its own balance of onboard enrichment and time ashore.

title: Celebrity Flora
short_introduction: Celebrity Flora is a 100-guest, all-suite expedition ship created specifically for the Galápagos Islands. Natural materials, Ecuadorian-inspired dining and expert-led exploration make the ship feel closely connected to the archipelago rather than separate from it.
full_overview:
Built for the Galápagos

Celebrity Flora is a purpose-built expedition yacht designed around immersion in the Galápagos Islands. Her small scale, natural materials and outward-facing spaces keep the landscape close, while a team of certified naturalists helps guests understand the wildlife, geology and conservation of the archipelago.

The atmosphere is relaxed and sociable, with guests returning from daily exploration to comfortable lounges, locally influenced food and places to continue the conversation. With only 100 guests, embarkation by tender and movement around the ship feel personal and unhurried.
staterooms:
All-suite accommodation

Every guest stays in a suite, with choices ranging from Sky Suites to larger Royal, Penthouse and Flora Suites. Full-room automation, premium bedding, thoughtful storage and dedicated suite attendants bring contemporary comfort to the expedition setting.

Many suites are designed to make the changing scenery part of the room, with generous windows or veranda-style spaces. The emphasis is on calm design, practical luxury and a restorative retreat between landings.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Flora

Food reflects the destination, with many ingredients grown, raised or caught in Ecuador and menus shaped around local flavours. The approach helps each meal continue the story of the islands.

Seaside Restaurant is the principal dining venue, while Ocean Grill provides an open-air alternative. The small-ship scale creates a relaxed experience with opportunities to share the day's discoveries over fresh, regionally inspired food.
entertainment:
Life on board

The Observatory and Discovery Lounge provide welcoming places for naturalist briefings, talks and informal gatherings. Darwin's Cove, The Vista and Sunset Lounge create quieter settings for reading, conversation and watching the islands pass.

A dedicated Stargazing Deck makes use of the dark Galápagos skies, while the ship's intimate atmosphere encourages guests and expedition specialists to exchange observations throughout the journey.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

Celebrity Flora has a spa for restorative treatments, a fitness room for maintaining an exercise routine and a hot tub for relaxing after time ashore.

Wellbeing is closely tied to the expedition rhythm: active landings and wildlife encounters are balanced by quiet spaces, open views and the ship's calm all-suite environment.
younger_travellers:
Travelling as a family

The Galápagos experience can be deeply rewarding for families with older children who are ready for active exploration and wildlife-focused days. Naturalist-led outings turn the islands into an open-air classroom.

Celebrity Flora is not centred on a conventional large-ship children's club, so families should check age guidance, activity requirements and the specific arrangements for their chosen departure before booking.
enrichment:
Expedition and enrichment

Certified naturalists lead small-group exploration, with two shore activities commonly included each day. Custom Novurania tenders help guests reach landing sites, while The Marina supports the practical side of expedition departures.

The Lab, stargazing programme and partnerships with scientific organisations deepen understanding of the islands. Selected experiences may include glamping under the stars, subject to the arrangements of the individual sailing.

title: Celebrity Infinity
short_introduction: Celebrity Infinity offers a relaxed Millennium Series experience with a comfortable scale, destination-led itineraries and familiar Celebrity favourites. AquaClass, The Retreat, Rooftop Terrace and a varied dining collection make her well suited to travellers who prefer an intimate ship with plenty of choice.
full_overview:
A comfortable way to see the world

Celebrity Infinity combines the easier scale of the Millennium Series with the restaurants, lounges and wellbeing experiences expected from Celebrity Cruises. Her public rooms feel sociable rather than overwhelming, with broad views from the Sky Observation Lounge and open-air time on the Rooftop Terrace.

Days can be shaped around the destination, the pool, spa or onboard activities, while evenings bring theatre, live music and relaxed bars. Starlink connectivity supports guests who want to stay in touch while travelling.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Inside, ocean-view and veranda rooms are joined by Concierge Class and AquaClass. AquaClass includes dining in Blu and access to the Persian Garden, while Concierge Class adds service touches and selected events.

The Retreat collection includes spacious suites with access to Luminae and The Retreat Lounge. Accessible accommodation and different room configurations help meet a range of travelling needs.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Infinity

The Main Restaurant provides the central dining experience, supported by Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service. Café al Bacio and Gelateria offers coffee, pastries and desserts.

Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef add speciality choice. Blu is exclusive to AquaClass, and Luminae serves guests staying in The Retreat.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Main Theatre presents production shows and visiting acts, while Rendezvous Lounge and Sky Observation Lounge provide live music and social space. Martini Bar, Cellar Masters and Sunset Bar suit different times and moods.

The Rooftop Terrace offers entertainment in the open air, complemented by Fortunes Casino, onboard events, shops, photography and the iLounge.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa and Persian Garden offer treatments and thermal relaxation, while the Fitness Centre provides equipment and organised sessions. Pickleball gives active guests another option outdoors.

The adults-only Solarium creates a quieter pool setting, with salon and barber services also available.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea provides supervised activities for children, including art, recreation, culinary sessions and age-appropriate games. Teenagers have their own opportunities to meet and join organised events.

Families can enjoy shows, pool time and shore excursions together. Autism-friendly support is available, and exact programmes vary by sailing.
enrichment:
Destination discovery

Celebrity Infinity's excursion programme extends the voyage ashore through cultural tours, scenic experiences, food-led outings and more active adventures.

The ship's observation spaces and manageable scale make her a comfortable base between ports, with itinerary-specific information available throughout the journey.

title: Celebrity Millennium
short_introduction: Celebrity Millennium combines a more intimate ship with a comprehensive modern redesign. Refreshed accommodation, The Retreat Sundeck and familiar Celebrity dining create a polished base for destination-rich voyages.
full_overview:
A modernised Millennium Series original

Celebrity Millennium has undergone an extensive renewal, bringing contemporary materials, updated technology and redesigned public spaces to the ship that gave the class its name. Her scale remains approachable, with observation lounges and open decks that suit scenic itineraries.

The Retreat introduces private spaces for suite guests, while the wider ship offers theatre, bars, pool time and relaxed places to watch the world pass. Starlink connectivity and refreshed accommodation add modern convenience throughout the voyage.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Suites and staterooms have been redesigned with updated bathrooms, improved storage and eXhale bedding. The selection includes inside, ocean-view and veranda rooms, plus Concierge Class and AquaClass.

The Retreat suite experience includes Luminae, a private lounge and dedicated sundeck. AquaClass guests receive Blu dining and Persian Garden access, while Concierge Class adds selected service benefits and events.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Millennium

The Main Restaurant is supported by Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service for flexible dining across the day. Café al Bacio and Gelateria serves coffee and sweet treats.

Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef provide speciality experiences. Blu serves AquaClass guests, while Luminae is reserved for The Retreat.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Main Theatre presents production shows and visiting entertainment, with the Grand Foyer, Rendezvous Lounge and Sky Lounge providing music and sociable evening spaces.

Martini Bar, Cellar Masters and Sunset Bar offer different settings for drinks. Guests can also enjoy the Rooftop Terrace, casino, shops, photography and organised parties and events.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa and Persian Garden support restorative days, while the Fitness Centre offers equipment and organised sessions. The Solarium provides an adults-only pool environment in a calmer part of the ship.

Suite guests have The Retreat Sundeck, and pickleball, salon and barber services broaden the wellbeing choices.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea offers supervised creative, recreational and educational activities for children, with separate opportunities for teenagers to socialise.

Family time can include the pool, shows, films and suitable excursions. Exact programmes vary by voyage, with autism-friendly support available.
enrichment:
Beyond the horizon

Excursions are tailored to each itinerary and can range from classic sightseeing to wildlife, food, culture and active exploration.

Celebrity Millennium's observation spaces and renewed comforts make her especially appealing when the scenery and time ashore are central to the holiday.

title: Celebrity Reflection
short_introduction: Celebrity Reflection expands the Solstice Series with additional space, distinctive suites and a strong outdoor-living character. The Lawn Club, Lawn Club Grill and The Porch create a relaxed resort feel, balanced by elegant dining and lively evening venues.
full_overview:
Solstice Series, with more room

Celebrity Reflection takes the familiar Solstice Series design and adds extra choice, including distinctive suite categories and more opportunities to dine outdoors. The real-grass Lawn Club gives the upper deck an unusually relaxed character, with sea views, games and space to slow down.

Inside, the Grand Foyer, Ensemble Lounge and Sky Observation Lounge create a range of social settings. The ship can feel energetic around the theatre and bars, yet still offers quiet corners and open decks for a more unhurried day.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

The accommodation collection includes inside, ocean-view and veranda rooms, Concierge Class and AquaClass. Reflection Suites and Signature Suites add options unique to the ship, alongside the wider Retreat suite range.

The Retreat includes access to Luminae and a private lounge, with dedicated service and added space. AquaClass guests dine in Blu and use the Persian Garden, while Concierge Class adds selected services and events.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Reflection

The Main Restaurant is complemented by Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service. Café al Bacio and Gelateria provides a relaxed stop for coffee and desserts.

Lawn Club Grill and The Porch make the most of the upper deck, while Murano, Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef provide a broad speciality collection. Blu is reserved for AquaClass and Luminae serves The Retreat.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Main Theatre hosts shows and guest acts, while Celebrity Central adds a more intimate entertainment space. Ensemble Lounge, Sky Observation Lounge and the Grand Foyer offer live music and sociable evenings.

The Hideaway and Lawn Club provide contrasting places to relax, and guests can also explore Martini Bar, World Class Bar, Passport Bar, Sunset Bar, the casino, gallery and shops.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa, Persian Garden and Fitness Centre support treatments, thermal relaxation and exercise. The adults-only Solarium offers a peaceful alternative to the main pool.

AquaClass adds wellness-oriented benefits, while salon and barber services provide further opportunities to unwind and prepare for the evening.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea gives children supervised activities across art, recreation, cookery and discovery, while teenagers have a separate social programme.

Families can spend time together at the pool, on the Lawn Club, at shows or during suitable excursions. Autism-friendly support is available, with schedules varying by voyage.
enrichment:
Discovery ashore

Excursions help guests explore local culture, landmarks, landscapes and food, with active and family-focused choices on many itineraries.

Back on board, the Lawn Club and observation spaces provide a relaxed setting to reflect on the day and look ahead to the next destination.

title: Celebrity Silhouette
short_introduction: Celebrity Silhouette blends refreshed interiors with the open-air appeal of the Solstice Series. The Lawn Club, Lawn Club Grill, The Porch and redesigned bars create a ship that feels polished yet easy-going from morning to night.
full_overview:
A refreshed resort at sea

Celebrity Silhouette has been updated across accommodation, bars, boutiques and spa spaces while retaining the features that distinguish the Solstice Series. The real-grass Lawn Club gives the upper deck a relaxed, spacious feel and creates a natural setting for food, conversation and ocean views.

Inside, the Grand Foyer, Sky Observation Lounge and Ensemble Lounge provide different places to gather. The Retreat adds private spaces for suite guests, while the wider ship balances theatre, nightlife and calm sea-day routines.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Redesigned accommodation includes inside, ocean-view and veranda rooms, Concierge Class and AquaClass, with refreshed finishes, practical storage and eXhale bedding.

The Retreat offers suites with access to Luminae, a private lounge and sundeck. AquaClass guests dine in Blu and use the Persian Garden, while Concierge Class adds selected service touches and events.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Silhouette

The Grand Cuvée Main Restaurant anchors the dining collection, with Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service providing informal alternatives.

Lawn Club Grill and The Porch take advantage of the open upper deck. Murano, Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef add speciality choice, while Luminae serves The Retreat and Blu is reserved for AquaClass.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Silhouette Theatre presents shows and guest entertainment, while Sky Observation Lounge, Ensemble Lounge and Quasar support live music, dancing and social evenings.

Craft Social, Martini Bar, World Class Bar, Passport Bar and Sunset Bar offer distinct settings for drinks. The Lawn Club, casino, gallery, library, shops and Grand Foyer create further ways to spend the evening.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The renewed Spa provides treatment rooms and restorative experiences, complemented by the Persian Garden and Fitness Centre. The Solarium creates an adults-only place to relax beside the pool.

Salon and barber services complete the wellbeing collection, while The Retreat Sundeck offers additional privacy for suite guests.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea offers supervised activities for children, ranging from creative projects and games to culinary and discovery sessions. Teenagers have their own social programme and meeting space.

Families can share pool time, Lawn Club activities, shows and suitable shore excursions. Autism-friendly support is available, subject to the arrangements of each sailing.
enrichment:
Meet, learn and explore

The Sky Conference Centre provides space for talks, meetings and group activity, while the excursion programme takes discovery ashore through cultural, scenic and active experiences.

On sea days, the Lawn Club and observation spaces make it easy to slow down and enjoy the journey itself.

title: Celebrity Solstice
short_introduction: Renewed Celebrity Solstice combines the ship's original Lawn Club character with new spaces including Sunset Park, Boulevard Lounge and The Parlor. Fresh dining and entertainment give this Solstice Series favourite a contemporary new chapter.
full_overview:
The original Solstice Series ship, renewed

Celebrity Solstice changed expectations with real grass at sea and an emphasis on open decks. Her latest renewal builds on that foundation with Sunset Park, new cabanas and social spaces designed for both daylight and evening.

Boulevard Lounge introduces duelling pianos, games and daytime activities, while The Parlor brings billiards, darts, board games and sport into a dedicated game bar. Familiar spaces such as Martini Bar, Sky Observation Lounge and the Grand Foyer remain central to life on board.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Celebrity Solstice offers a high proportion of veranda accommodation alongside inside and ocean-view rooms. Concierge Class adds thoughtful service, while AquaClass includes Blu and access to the Persian Garden.

The Retreat suite collection offers more space, dedicated service, Luminae dining and private lounge and sundeck areas. Accessible accommodation and varied room categories support different travelling parties.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Solstice

The Main Restaurant is supported by Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service. Café al Bacio and Gelateria remains a popular setting for coffee and something sweet.

The renewed dining collection includes Trattoria Rossa and Fine Cut Steakhouse alongside Murano, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef. Blu serves AquaClass guests and Luminae is exclusive to The Retreat.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Solstice Theatre presents production shows and visiting acts, while Boulevard Lounge adds duelling pianos, game shows and bingo. The Parlor offers a more informal game-led evening.

The Lawn Club, Sunset Park and new cabanas extend social life outdoors. Guests can also choose Martini Bar, World Class Bar, Passport Bar, Craft Social, Ensemble Lounge, the casino and Sky Observation Lounge.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa offers a wide treatment collection and the Persian Garden's thermal environment, while the Fitness Centre provides equipment and organised sessions.

The Solarium is reserved for adults seeking a quieter pool setting. Pickleball, salon and barber services add further active and restorative choices.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea adapts creative, recreational, culinary and STEM activities to the children travelling, while teenagers have their own space and programme.

Sunset Park, the pool, theatre and game-led venues create opportunities for families to spend time together. Autism-friendly support is available, and exact arrangements vary by sailing.
enrichment:
Creativity and discovery

The Hot Glass Class Studio brings a hands-on creative experience to the upper deck, while the Sky Conference Centre can host talks and group sessions.

Excursions extend the journey into each destination through culture, scenery, food and active exploration, with choices shaped around the itinerary.

title: Celebrity Summit
short_introduction: Celebrity Summit is a comprehensively redesigned Millennium Series ship with refreshed rooms, The Retreat Sundeck and a comfortable, intimate scale. She combines modern Celebrity touches with destination-focused itineraries and sociable public spaces.
full_overview:
A smaller ship with a fresh outlook

Celebrity Summit's redesign introduced new staterooms, contemporary finishes and updated technology across the ship. Her Millennium Series proportions remain easy to navigate, making her appealing to guests who value a more intimate atmosphere.

The Rooftop Terrace, Sky Lounge and open decks provide sea views and relaxed gathering places. The Retreat gives suite guests private spaces, while theatre, bars and the Grand Foyer bring energy to the wider ship after dark.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Redesigned accommodation includes inside, ocean-view and veranda rooms, Concierge Class and AquaClass, with updated bathrooms, practical storage and eXhale bedding.

The Retreat suite experience includes Luminae, a private lounge and dedicated sundeck. AquaClass adds Blu and Persian Garden access, while Concierge Class provides selected arrival and service benefits.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Summit

The Main Restaurant is supported by Oceanview Café, the Pool and Mast Grill, Spa Café and room service. Café al Bacio and Gelateria serves coffee and desserts.

Tuscan Grille, Sushi on Five and Le Petit Chef provide speciality choice. Blu is reserved for AquaClass, and Luminae serves guests of The Retreat.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Theatre hosts production shows and visiting entertainment, while Rendezvous Lounge and Sky Lounge offer music, dancing and conversation.

Martini Bar, Cellar Masters and Sunset Bar suit different moods, with the Rooftop Terrace, casino, Grand Foyer, shops and organised events adding further options.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa and Persian Garden offer treatments and thermal relaxation, while the Fitness Centre supports independent exercise and classes. The Solarium provides a calmer adults-only pool environment.

Suite guests have The Retreat Sundeck, and pickleball, salon and barber services complete the wellbeing programme.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea offers supervised activities for children, including creative, recreational and educational sessions. Teenagers have their own opportunities to meet and take part in events.

Families can share pool time, theatre and suitable excursions. Autism-friendly support is available, with exact programmes varying by departure.
enrichment:
Destination discovery

Excursions are selected around each itinerary, with possibilities spanning landmarks, culture, food, wildlife and more active days.

The ship's observation spaces and manageable scale provide a comfortable setting for scenic cruising and time between ports.

title: Celebrity Xcel
short_introduction: Celebrity Xcel brings a destination-led energy to the Edge Series, combining familiar favourites with The Bazaar, new dining concepts and the Celebrity Pool Club. Culture, flavour and entertainment from the places visited are designed to continue on board.
full_overview:
A new Edge Series chapter

Celebrity Xcel builds on the outward-facing architecture of the Edge Series while introducing spaces that deliberately blur the boundary between ship and shore. The Bazaar changes with the itinerary, bringing local food, music, craft and festivals into a lively multi-level setting.

The Rooftop Garden, Magic Carpet, Grand Plaza and expanded Sunset Bar retain the open, contemporary character of the class. New spaces including The Annex and Attic at The Club add private and late-night entertainment possibilities.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Accommodation includes Infinite Verandas that bring the outside into the room, alongside veranda, ocean-view and inside choices. Concierge Class and AquaClass add service and wellbeing benefits.

The Retreat provides a private suite experience with Luminae, an exclusive lounge and sundeck. A range of suite categories offers additional living space and elevated views, supported by dedicated service.
dining:
Dining aboard Celebrity Xcel

The Bazaar introduces destination-inspired food through Mosaic, Bora, Spice and The Market, with menus and experiences designed to change with the regions visited. Chef's Studio adds a more participatory culinary element.

Main dining remains part of the ship's wider restaurant collection, while Luminae serves The Retreat. The Magic Carpet provides one of the ship's most distinctive sea-facing settings for drinks and selected dining experiences.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

The Bazaar brings regional festivals, performance and culture on board, changing character with the itinerary. The Theatre, The Club and Grand Plaza provide large-scale shows, music and sociable evenings.
