The Annex can be used for private, customisable experiences, while Attic at The Club adds a later-night venue. Rooftop Garden, Sunset Bar, casino and the Magic Carpet keep the open-air Edge Series identity close at hand.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Spa offers Celebrity's established treatment and wellbeing collection, while the Solarium provides an adults-only place to slow down.

The Celebrity Pool Club gives the main pool deck a more flexible identity, shifting from relaxed daytime resort to a livelier social setting on selected occasions.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Camp at Sea provides adaptable activities for children, drawing on art, recreation, culinary discovery and science. Teenagers have their own social space and organised events.

The pool deck, theatre, destination-led Bazaar and family excursions create opportunities to spend time together. Exact schedules and autism-friendly support vary by sailing.
enrichment:
The destination comes aboard

The Bazaar is central to Xcel's enrichment approach, using markets, festivals, food and performance to reflect the places on the itinerary. Chef's Studio offers a closer look at regional ingredients and techniques.

Ashore, excursions extend that connection through culture, landscapes, food and active exploration, with each sailing shaping the exact programme.

A future Celebrity ship

Celebrity Xcite is due to join the fleet in 2028. Celebrity Cruises has revealed the ship's name and an ambition to create an experience designed to excite every sense, with fuller details to follow.

title: Crown Princess
short_introduction: Crown Princess is a welcoming, destination-focused ship with almost 900 balconies, a dramatic three-storey Piazza and a generous choice of dining and entertainment. She provides a comfortable base for exploring ashore while keeping sea days varied, sociable and easy to enjoy at your own pace.
full_overview:
Your comfortable escort to the world

Crown Princess is designed around the pleasure of travelling: wide ocean views, plenty of private balconies and a relaxed atmosphere to return to after each day ashore. At the centre of the ship, the three-storey Piazza brings together cafés, entertainment and places to pause, creating a lively meeting point from morning until evening.

Elsewhere, open decks, freshwater pools and comfortable lounges give guests room to shape the day for themselves. The experience reflects Princess Cruises at its best—friendly service, accessible choice and a strong connection to the destinations on the itinerary.

Whether the priority is an unhurried meal, a film beneath the stars, live theatre or simply watching the horizon from a balcony, Crown Princess makes it easy to settle into the rhythm of the voyage.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Crown Princess offers accommodation for couples, solo travellers and families, ranging from practical Interior rooms to spacious suites. Oceanview rooms frame the changing scenery, while the ship's large number of Balcony staterooms gives many guests their own private outdoor space.

Mini-Suites and Reserve Collection

Mini-Suites add a separate sitting area and more room to unwind. Reserve Collection accommodation introduces selected benefits and a more elevated onboard experience, including dedicated dining arrangements where available.

Suites and family accommodation

Suites provide generous living space and additional comforts, while the Two Bedroom Family Suite with Balcony is designed for larger travelling parties who want to stay together. Exact layouts, furnishings and features vary between categories and individual rooms.

Across the collection, the emphasis is on creating a welcoming home away from home, supported by attentive Princess service throughout the sailing.
dining:
Dining aboard Crown Princess

Princess chefs prepare a wide range of food throughout the day, from freshly baked pastries and casual poolside favourites to multi-course dinners. Dine My Way helps guests choose dining times and arrangements that suit the pace of their holiday.

Relaxed and included choices

Horizon Court offers extensive buffet choice, while International Café serves light bites in the heart of the Piazza. Slice Pizzeria, The Salty Dog Grill and Coffee & Cones make informal meals and treats easy to fit around a day by the pool or ashore. Afternoon Tea and 24-hour room service add further flexibility.

Speciality dining

Sabatini's celebrates Italian flavours, while Crown Grill specialises in premium steaks and seafood. The Chef's Table Experience creates a more intimate culinary occasion, and selected sailings may also offer Crab Shack.

Something to savour

Chocolate Journeys brings crafted chocolate desserts to the ship, Vines Wine Bar offers a relaxed setting for a glass of wine, and Ultimate Balcony Dining turns a private balcony into a memorable setting for a special meal.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Crown Princess offers entertainment from large theatre productions to live music, comedy, dancing and films beneath the open sky.

Princess Theatre

The main theatre hosts original musical productions, guest entertainers, comedy and other headline performances. The Voice of the Ocean gives the familiar singing competition a lively at-sea setting.

Movies Under the Stars

The pool deck becomes an outdoor cinema, with feature films shown on the large screen and the sea as a backdrop.

Music, dancing and nightlife

Club Fusion, Explorer's Lounge and Skywalkers Nightclub provide different settings for dancing and late-night entertainment. Crooner's Bar, Wheelhouse Bar and Adagio Bar offer more relaxed places for conversation, cocktails and live music.

The Piazza hosts performances and spontaneous activity throughout the day, while Festivals of the World bring destination-inspired celebrations on board. Guests can also visit the casino, shops, photo gallery, internet café and library.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

Crown Princess makes room for active days and quieter restoration, with freshwater pools, hot tubs and dedicated wellbeing spaces across the ship.

Lotus Spa

The Lotus Spa offers treatments designed to relax and refresh, while the accompanying fitness centre provides modern equipment for guests who want to maintain their routine at sea.

The Sanctuary

Reserved for adults, The Sanctuary is a tranquil top-deck retreat with comfortable loungers and attentive service, offering a calmer alternative to the main pool areas.

Staying active

The sports court and Princess Links provide opportunities for friendly competition, while the open decks make fresh air and sea views part of the experience.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Princess youth programmes combine supervised activities with opportunities for families to enjoy the voyage together. Activities are designed to spark creativity, curiosity and new friendships, with exact schedules shaped around each sailing.

Ages 3 to 7

Younger children can take part in age-appropriate games, crafts and imaginative activities in a dedicated supervised setting.

Ages 8 to 12

Older children have their own programme of challenges, creative projects, games and discovery-led sessions.

Ages 13 to 17

Teenagers can meet others of a similar age through social events, games and organised activities in their own space.

Family time can include Movies Under the Stars, pool days, live entertainment and shore excursions chosen to engage different generations.
enrichment:
Learn more as you travel

Crown Princess extends the destination experience beyond time ashore through area lectures, art displays and classes led by local or specialist experts. The programme helps guests gain context for the landscapes, culture and history encountered along the way.

Activities vary with the itinerary, making enrichment feel connected to the voyage rather than separate from it. Together with the ship's excursion programme, these sessions offer different ways to look more closely at each destination.

title: Caribbean Princess
short_introduction: Caribbean Princess is a relaxed, family-friendly ship with refreshed dining, lively entertainment and a dedicated Reef Splash Zone. From Movies Under the Stars to The Sanctuary and a broad choice of casual food, she is designed for carefree days in warm-weather destinations.
full_overview:
Carefree days at sea

Caribbean Princess combines the welcoming service of Princess Cruises with an easy-going resort atmosphere. Refreshed venues, broad open decks and a lively central programme give guests plenty to do without making the ship feel overly formal.

Families have the Reef Splash Zone and youth spaces, while adults can retreat to The Sanctuary or enjoy bars, live entertainment and quiet sea views. The ship works particularly well as a comfortable base for port-rich Caribbean adventures.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Accommodation ranges from practical Interior and Oceanview rooms to Balcony staterooms, Mini-Suites and spacious suites. Family-friendly configurations and connecting options support larger travelling parties.

Balcony accommodation gives many guests a private place to enjoy warm evenings and port arrivals. Across the range, attentive service and comfortable bedding create a welcoming home between days ashore.
dining:
Dining aboard Caribbean Princess

World Fresh Marketplace offers a broad buffet selection, while International Café, Slice, The Salty Dog Grill and Coffee & Cones make informal meals easy throughout the day.

Speciality choices include Sabatini's Italian Trattoria, Crown Grill, Steamers Seafood and Planks BBQ. Chef's Table and Ultimate Balcony Dining create more intimate occasions, while Chocolate Journeys and 24-hour room service add indulgence and flexibility.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Princess Theatre hosts production shows and visiting acts, while Movies Under the Stars turns the pool deck into an open-air cinema. Explorer's Lounge and Club Fusion offer entertainment and dancing, with Skywalkers continuing later into the night.

Crooner's, Wheelhouse Bar, Vines and Adagio provide more relaxed settings. Guests can also visit the casino, shops, library, photo gallery and the ship's changing programme of music and activities.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Lotus Spa and fitness centre provide treatments, exercise equipment and organised sessions. The Sanctuary is an adults-only top-deck retreat for guests seeking a quieter pace.

Freshwater pools, hot tubs, sports facilities and Princess Links offer active alternatives, making it easy to balance relaxation with time outdoors.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Supervised youth programmes serve children and teenagers with creative activities, games, films and social events. Children under three may visit the youth centre with a supervising parent.

The Reef Splash Zone gives families a dedicated outdoor play area, while pools, films and selected excursions create opportunities for different generations to spend time together.
enrichment:
Discovery throughout the voyage

Destination talks, cultural activities and Princess programmes help guests understand the places on the itinerary. Festivals and themed events may bring regional music, food and traditions aboard.

Shore excursions extend that discovery through sightseeing, nature, food and family-friendly experiences, with choices varying by sailing.

title: Coral Princess
short_introduction: Coral Princess was purpose-built for destination-rich voyages and the historic Panama Canal, with more than 700 balcony staterooms and an intimate scale. Bayou Café, Movies Under the Stars and broad viewing areas make her a distinctive ship for scenic journeys.
full_overview:
Created for voyages of discovery

Coral Princess was designed to navigate the Panama Canal, giving her a smaller, more intimate profile than many newer ships. Generous balcony accommodation and accessible viewing areas make the changing landscape a central part of the voyage.

Her atmosphere is comfortable and traditional, with the Atrium, Universe Lounge and open decks providing natural places to gather. Dining, theatre and poolside films add variety without distracting from the destinations themselves.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

More than 700 Balcony staterooms give many guests a private view, joined by Interior and Oceanview rooms, Mini-Suites and suites. The choice suits couples, solo travellers and families across different budgets.

Princess bedding and attentive steward service create a comfortable base for longer itineraries and scenic days. Layouts and furnishings vary by category and location.
dining:
Dining aboard Coral Princess

Horizon Court, International Café, Princess Pizzeria and The Bar & Grill cover relaxed meals and snacks. Dine My Way helps guests arrange dinner around their preferred schedule.

Bayou Café & Steakhouse is the ship's distinctive speciality venue, combining steaks with New Orleans-inspired Cajun and Creole flavours. Sabatini's offers Italian dining, while Chef's Table, Crab Shack and Ultimate Balcony Dining create further occasions.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Princess Theatre and Universe Lounge host productions, music, comedy and guest performers. Movies Under the Stars brings feature films to the pool deck, while Explorers Lounge offers a more intimate entertainment setting.

Good Spirits at Sea, Wheelhouse Bar and Crooners provide contrasting places for drinks. The casino, shops, art gallery and Atrium complete the evening choice.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Lotus Spa and fitness centre support treatments, exercise and restorative time. The Sanctuary provides an adults-only retreat away from the busier pool areas.

Freshwater pools, hot tubs and the sports centre offer active and sociable alternatives, especially on sea days.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Youth centres and teen lounges offer supervised activities for ages 3 to 17, including art, games, films, parties and talent events. Children under three may use the youth centre with a parent.

Families can also enjoy Movies Under the Stars, pools and suitable shore excursions together.
enrichment:
Understanding the journey

On destination-led sailings, talks and activities can add context to the geography, engineering and culture encountered along the route. The Panama Canal is particularly suited to expert commentary and time spent on deck.

Excursions provide closer access to local history, landscapes and wildlife, with options shaped around each itinerary.

title: Diamond Princess
short_introduction: Diamond Princess combines familiar Princess service with distinctive Japanese touches, including Kai Sushi and the IZUMI Japanese Bath. Generous staterooms, varied dining and broad entertainment make her especially appealing for longer voyages in Asia and beyond.
full_overview:
Princess cruising with a Japanese influence

Diamond Princess offers the range and comfort of a large Princess ship with several experiences shaped by her time in Japan. Traditional bathing at IZUMI, Japanese dining and destination celebrations give her a character that differs from the wider fleet.

Five principal dining rooms, a spacious Atrium and plenty of balcony accommodation help distribute guests around the ship. Days can centre on exploration ashore, pool time or spa relaxation, with theatre and nightlife after dinner.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

The ship offers Interior, Oceanview and Balcony rooms alongside Mini-Suites and a broad suite collection. Sizes vary significantly, allowing guests to choose between a practical base and more expansive living space.

Balconies provide private views on scenic itineraries, while steward service and thoughtful amenities support longer journeys. Family and accessible options are available within selected categories.
dining:
Dining aboard Diamond Princess

International, Santa Fe, Vivaldi, Pacific Moon and Savoy dining rooms provide flexible main dining, supported by Horizon Court, Trident Grill, Prego Pizzeria and La Patisserie.

Kai Sushi reflects the ship's Japanese influence, while Sabatini's and Sterling Steakhouse add Italian and steakhouse choices. Chef's Table, Afternoon Tea, Ultimate Balcony Dining and Chocolate Journeys create further variety.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Princess Theatre hosts production shows and visiting performers, while Explorer's Lounge and Club Fusion offer music, events and dancing. Skywalkers Nightclub provides a late-night setting high on the ship.

Movies Under the Stars, Wheelhouse Bar, Crooners and the casino give evenings different moods. Festivals of the World, shops, galleries and photography add further activity.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

IZUMI Japanese Bath is the ship's standout wellbeing experience, offering indoor and open-air bathing traditions in a serene setting. The Lotus Spa and fitness centre add treatments and exercise facilities.

The Sanctuary, freshwater pools, hot tubs, Conservatory and sports facilities provide both quiet and active ways to spend a sea day.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Supervised youth and teen spaces provide art, games, films, parties and social activities for ages 3 to 17. Children under three may visit with a supervising parent.

Families can share pool time, films, destination festivals and suitable shore excursions, with exact activities varying by sailing.
enrichment:
Culture on board and ashore

Festivals, regional food and destination programming can bring the character of the itinerary on board. On Asia sailings, these experiences complement the ship's Japanese-influenced facilities.

Excursions offer ways to explore temples, cities, landscapes, cuisine and local traditions, with choices tailored to each port.

title: Discovery Princess
short_introduction: Discovery Princess is the final Royal-class ship, designed around MedallionClass convenience, sweeping views and contemporary dining. Large balconies, The Sanctuary and venues such as Take Five and Princess Live create a polished resort experience at sea.
full_overview:
The Royal class, fully realised

Discovery Princess brings together the most developed features of the Royal-class design. The expansive Piazza forms the social heart of the ship, while broad decks and some of the fleet's largest balconies keep the ocean close.

MedallionClass technology supports a more seamless holiday, from locating companions to ordering selected food and drinks. Theatre, jazz, dining and adults-only relaxation give sea days a strong sense of choice.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Accommodation includes Interior rooms, Balcony staterooms, Deluxe Balconies, Mini-Suites and suites. Larger balcony categories create particularly impressive outdoor space on selected rooms.

Family and connecting options support groups, while premium categories add more room and additional services. Layouts vary by deck and cabin position.
dining:
Dining aboard Discovery Princess

World Fresh Marketplace, International Café, Gigi's Pizzeria, Slice, The Salty Dog Grill and Gelato offer easy choices throughout the day.

Speciality dining includes Crown Grill, Sabatini's, Bistro Sur La Mer, Ocean Terrace and The Salty Dog Gastropub. Chef's Table Lumiere and Ultimate Balcony Dining create more exclusive occasions, with Dine My Way adding flexibility.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Princess Theatre and Vista Show Lounge host productions and guest performers. Take Five is dedicated to live jazz, while Princess Live and its café bring quizzes, demonstrations and interactive entertainment into a television-studio setting.

Movies Under the Stars, the Piazza, Crooners, Good Spirits and the casino provide further choice. Top-deck parties, music and Festivals of the World extend entertainment across the ship.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Lotus Spa and Enclave provide treatments and thermal experiences, while the fitness centre and sports court support active days.

The Sanctuary is an adults-only retreat, complemented by the Retreat Pool, Wakeview Pool and top-deck pools for different moods.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Princess youth programmes offer supervised creative, recreational and discovery-led activities for children and teenagers. Dedicated spaces help different age groups socialise independently.

Families can share films, pools, Piazza entertainment and shore excursions, with the exact programme changing by voyage.
enrichment:
Discovery at sea

Festivals of the World and destination programming connect the ship to the cultures on the itinerary. Talks, demonstrations and Princess activities provide context between ports.

Excursions cover sightseeing, scenery, food, wildlife and active adventures, giving guests several ways to experience each destination.

title: Emerald Princess
short_introduction: Emerald Princess is a grand, sociable ship with an especially broad casual-dining collection. The Piazza, Movies Under the Stars, The Sanctuary and venues ranging from Planks BBQ to Steamers Seafood make her easy to enjoy on both sea days and port-rich itineraries.
full_overview:
Grand in scale, relaxed in spirit

Emerald Princess combines a wide choice of restaurants and entertainment with the familiar warmth of Princess service. The Piazza acts as a lively central meeting place, while open decks, pools and lounges let guests find their own pace.

Recent dining additions bring more casual variety to the top deck. Evenings move between theatre, cinema, dancing and relaxed bars, creating a ship that suits couples, friends and multigenerational families.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

Interior, Oceanview and Balcony accommodation is joined by Mini-Suites and suites. Balcony rooms provide a private outdoor retreat, while larger categories add separate living areas and extra space.

Family and accessible choices are available in selected locations. Attentive steward service and comfortable bedding support both short breaks and longer journeys.
dining:
Dining aboard Emerald Princess

World Fresh Marketplace, International Café, Slice, The Salty Dog Grill and Coffee & Cones cover casual meals and snacks.

Crown Grill provides a classic steakhouse experience, while Planks BBQ and Steamers Seafood add relaxed speciality dining. Chef's Table, Ultimate Balcony Dining, Afternoon Tea and Chocolate Journeys create further ways to make a meal feel special.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Princess Theatre hosts productions and guest performers, while Movies Under the Stars brings cinema to the pool deck. Explorer's Lounge and Club Fusion offer events and dancing, with Skywalkers continuing late into the night.

The Piazza, Crooner's, Good Spirits, Adagio and Vines provide different social settings. Guests can also visit the casino, shops, gallery, library and photography studio.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Lotus Spa and fitness centre offer treatments and exercise, while The Sanctuary is reserved for adults seeking a quieter top-deck retreat.

Freshwater pools, hot tubs, the sports centre and Princess Links give active guests a range of outdoor options.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Supervised youth programmes for ages 3 to 17 may include art, games, films, parties and social events. Teenagers have their own opportunities to meet and spend time together.

Families can share Movies Under the Stars, pool days and suitable shore excursions. Children under three may access youth spaces with a supervising parent where permitted.
enrichment:
More from every destination

Princess destination talks, cultural celebrations and themed activities can add meaning to the itinerary. The programme varies according to the regions visited.

Excursions extend discovery ashore through landmarks, local food, scenery, wildlife and active experiences.

title: Enchanted Princess
short_introduction: Enchanted Princess combines Royal-class style with abundant pools, sophisticated dining and contemporary entertainment. Sky Suites with exceptionally large balconies, Take Five jazz and The Enclave create a modern Princess holiday with room for both energy and escape.
full_overview:
Contemporary Princess style

Enchanted Princess uses the spacious Royal-class design to create a holiday centred on the Piazza, open decks and an extensive pool collection. The ship feels polished yet welcoming, with MedallionClass convenience woven into everyday life.

World-class entertainment, relaxed cafés and adults-only spaces allow guests to shift easily between lively and quiet. The result suits travellers who want plenty of choice while exploring destinations in Princess comfort.
staterooms:
Staterooms and suites

The range includes Interior rooms, Balcony and Deluxe Balcony staterooms, Mini-Suites and suites. Selected Sky Suites feature some of the largest balconies at sea, creating exceptional outdoor living space for families or groups.

Connecting rooms and family configurations broaden the choice, while premium categories add more space and services.
dining:
Dining aboard Enchanted Princess

World Fresh Marketplace, International Café, Gigi's Pizzeria, Slice, The Salty Dog Grill and Gelato provide relaxed dining from morning to late evening.

Crown Grill, Sabatini's, Bistro Sur La Mer and Ocean Terrace lead the speciality collection. Chef's Table Lumiere and Ultimate Balcony Dining offer intimate occasions, with Dine My Way supporting flexible dinner plans.
entertainment:
Entertainment and evenings

Princess Theatre and Vista Show Lounge present productions and guest acts. Take Five offers live jazz, while Princess Live hosts games, demonstrations and interactive entertainment.

The Piazza, Crooners, Bellini's, Good Spirits and the casino create varied evening moods. Movies Under the Stars and the Phantom Bridge escape room add experiences beyond conventional theatre.
health_fitness:
Health, fitness and relaxation

The Lotus Spa, fitness centre and Enclave thermal suite provide treatments, exercise and deep relaxation. The Sanctuary offers an adults-only top-deck retreat.

Retreat, Wakeview and main pools, hot tubs and the sports court give guests both peaceful and active ways to enjoy the open air.
younger_travellers:
Younger travellers

Dedicated youth and teen spaces support supervised creative, recreational and discovery-focused activities. Programmes vary with the age mix and itinerary.

Families can share pools, films, Piazza entertainment and shore excursions, with options suited to several generations.
enrichment:
Culture and discovery

Discovery at Sea, Festivals of the World and destination programming connect onboard activity to the places visited. Talks and demonstrations add context between ports.

Excursions range from classic sightseeing to food, nature and active adventures, depending on the itinerary.

title: Grand Princess
short_introduction: Grand Princess offers a traditional Princess experience with a generous Piazza, relaxed top-deck dining and varied entertainment. The Sanctuary, Movies Under the Stars and familiar favourites such as Sabatini's and Crown Grill make her a comfortable choice for destination-led cruising.
full_overview:
A Princess classic

Grand Princess helped shape the fleet's modern identity and retains an easy, welcoming atmosphere. The Piazza brings cafés and entertainment together, while open decks and broad lounges provide space to settle into the voyage.

Top-deck dining, theatre and Movies Under the Stars give sea days variety. The ship feels particularly suited to travellers who prefer familiar venues and a comfortable scale over the newest resort-style features.

title: Island Princess
short_introduction: Island Princess is an intimate floating retreat built for destination-rich voyages. With Bayou Café, a welcoming Atrium, The Sanctuary and broad viewing opportunities, she balances scenic discovery with traditional Princess comfort.
full_overview:
A retreat shaped around the journey

Island Princess shares the narrower profile created for Panama Canal cruising, making her well suited to scenic routes and ports that reward a smaller ship. Her atmosphere is relaxed and traditional, with the Atrium and open decks forming natural gathering places.

Guests can move from destination days to spa time, live entertainment and relaxed dining without the scale of the newest megaships. This makes her appealing for longer and more immersive itineraries.

title: Star Princess
short_introduction: Star Princess is a Sphere-class ship designed to bring the world closer through expansive views, contemporary spaces and next-generation entertainment. The Dome, Piazza and Princess Arena sit alongside destination-led dining and welcoming Princess service.
full_overview:
A brighter new generation

Star Princess follows sister ship Sun Princess as part of the Sphere class, using glass, light and wide sea views to create a stronger connection between ship and destination. The multi-level Piazza and transformational Dome form two dramatic social centres.

Princess Arena introduces a flexible theatre setting, while open terraces and the Cabana Deck extend life outdoors. The overall experience combines the familiarity of Princess with a more contemporary resort design.

Designed to shine

Sun Princess uses sweeping curves, glass and open views to put the sea at the centre of the ship. The Piazza rises through several levels as a flexible social and performance space, while The Dome transforms from daytime relaxation to evening entertainment.

Wake View Terrace, Sea View Terrace and broad open decks create different perspectives on the journey. The ship retains Princess warmth while introducing a more modern, architectural resort experience.
